subject: Hosted API evaluation — scheduling, sandbox access and SSO check
body:
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@auroracorp.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick evaluation for Hosted API — sandbox + 30m demo

Hi Chloe,

We signed up for the Hosted API sandbox yesterday and I wanted to see if we could schedule a short 30-minute evaluation this week. Goal: validate latency/cost for a 512-token generation baseline and sanity-check SSO/ingestion for a small internal dataset.

A little about us: Aurora Corp (martech) — I’m Maria (platform lead). We have an early PLG flow and want to prototype hooking the Redwood Hosted API into our experiments by EOY.

Can you send a couple of times? Also would like a sandbox account and any quickstart notes.

Thanks,
Maria Garcia
Platform Lead, Aurora Corp
---

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@auroracorp.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick evaluation for Hosted API — sandbox + 30m demo

Hi Maria — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood.

We can absolutely run a quick Hosted API evaluation and provision a sandbox ahead of the call. Quick options tomorrow/this week:
- Wed, Dec 15 — 09:00 AM PST / 17:00 CET (30 min)
- Thu, Dec 16 — 11:00 AM PST / 20:00 CET (30 min)

If neither works, tell us a preferred day/time (timezone) and we’ll try to adjust.

What we’ll cover in 30 min:
- Basic Hosted API walkthrough and perf expectations for 512-token runs
- Sandbox credentials and brief demo of prefix-caching behavior
- Outline of SSO approach and what we need from your side to validate SSO

I’m attaching a one-pager with quickstart steps (redwood-quickstart-one-pager.pdf). Diego (cc’d) will send a Calendly link and create the sandbox slot once you confirm the time.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
--- Attachment: redwood-quickstart-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@auroracorp.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Quick evaluation for Hosted API — calendar invite + sandbox prep

Maria — dropping in the Calendly link so you can pick the slot that fits. If you pick one of Chloe’s suggested windows I’ll claim a pre-provisioned sandbox and drop credentials here (or send via secure note).

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min-hostedapi
Sandbox (provisioning URL): https://console.redwood.ai/sandbox/aurora-123

I’ll attach a tiny claim file to help ops tie the sandbox to your account (sandbox-claim.txt).

— Diego
SDR, Redwood Inference
--- Attachment: sandbox-claim.txt (text/plain)

From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@auroracorp.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick evaluation for Hosted API — scheduling, sandbox access and SSO check

Thanks — the Wed/Thu slots look a bit tight for our EU engineering team. Would Thu, Dec 16 at 10:00 AM CET work instead? (That’s our preferred overlap window.)

Also, we have an internal SSO requirements doc to validate before the call. I attached the short doc — it lists our IdP (AuthMate) and a couple of required claims. If possible, we’d like to make sure SSO is on the table during the call so our infra owner can join.

Attaching: sso_requirements.docx

Best,
Maria
--- Attachment: sso_requirements.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@auroracorp.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick evaluation for Hosted API — scheduling, sandbox access and SSO check

Hi Maria — Thu, Dec 16 at 10:00 AM CET works for us. I’ve penciled it in on our side.

Diego — can you send the official calendar invite for Thu 16 Dec 10:00 CET / (01:00 PST) and attach the sandbox credentials via secure note? Please include Jonas (cc’d) — he’ll be our solutions engineer on the call to walk through SSO details.

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m: Intros + goals
- 10m: Hosted API perf & quick demo on 512-token baseline
- 10m: SSO requirements & next steps for validation
- 5m: Follow-up items (trial timeline, quota, handoff to CS)

Maria — thanks for the SSO doc — Jonas will review ahead of time. If anything changes, ping us here and we’ll adapt.

See you Thu — Chloe
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
---

[End of thread]
